def chain_follows_chain(chain):
    chain_list = list(chain)
    chain_list.sort()
    result = []
    for i in range(len(chain_list)):
        if chain_list[i] == chain_list[i+1]:
            result.append(chain_list[i])
            continue
        if chain_list[i] == chain_list[i+1][::-1]:
            result.append(chain_list[i])
            continue
        break
    return ','.join(result)
